items.name: Maltese Championship 2026
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjAxNzQ1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--417935762bfb96f37d3a4122e860cb7a459231ec/91697.jpg)

Welcome to Maltese Championship 2026, the fourth official WCA competition in Malta!

Whether you’re competing for the first time or returning for another competition, we’re excited to welcome you to our growing speedcubing community.

Competitors from all countries are warmly invited to take part. While prizes and national titles are reserved for Maltese competitors, every participant will compete on equal terms and receive official WCA results.

Our aim is to make Maltese Championship 2026 our biggest and most welcoming competition yet, bringing together cubers of all ages and experience levels for a memorable day of competition and community. 

Be sure to check all tabs, especially [if you are a new competitor](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalteseChampionship2026#76640-for-new-competitors).

**Registration is only possible online through this website. Check the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalteseChampionship2026/register) section for details.**

[T-shirts are available to order](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalteseChampionship2026#78743-championship-t-shirt-competitors-supporters) for competitors and supporters by the 6th September 2026.

items.name: Malta End of Summer 2025

venue.name: [The University of Malta](https://www.um.edu.mt/)
venue.details: KSU-PWC Common Room, Student’s House, University of Malta MSD2080

items.information:
Welcome to the third official WCA competition in Malta!
Please check all tabs, especially [if you are a new competitor](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MaltaEndofSummer2025#55260-for-new-competitors).
Please also check the [competition schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MaltaEndofSummer2025#competition-schedule) in the dedicated tab, as the competition will start in the early morning with some advanced events, be interrupted for a few hours by [FMC Europe 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MaltaEndofSummer2025#63651-fmc-europe-2025) and continue in the afternoon with the most popular events.

items.name: Malta Open 2024

venue.name: [The University of Malta](https://www.um.edu.mt/)
venue.address: Mathematics and Physics Building, University of Malta, Msida MSD 2080, Malta.

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzY3NTIsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--345fb6f71661c618d769cbb8e8ab588aae97b650/Logo%20Malta%20Open%202024%202.png)

This is the second WCA competition in Malta. It is an open competition for all people from all ages and all countries.
We hope many people from Malta and other countries will participate.

The competition also counts as the national championship for Malta: the best competitors from Malta will be the national champions 2024 of Malta.
